title: Quest Line 02 — The Six Bells
premise: Director Krampus escaped with the Krampus Bell — but the bell was only one of six. Scattered across the region, the remaining bells each hold a fraction of the Winterheart's power. Ring all six and the seal beneath Frostpine breaks. The player must find the bells before the scattered remnants of Team Krampus regroup under a new face.
theme: Who rings the bells — and what answers?

chapters.name: Chapter I — Aftershock
chapters.description: The Keep stands empty. Krampus is gone — and so is the bell. The hunt begins.

chapters.name: Chapter II — The Hunter
chapters.description: A monster hunter named Sigrun is also tracking the bells. She is not friendly — and she is not wrong.

chapters.name: Chapter III — The Echo Cult
chapters.description: A quiet sect has worshipped the bells for generations. They believe ringing them is a mercy.

chapters.name: Chapter IV — The Fifth Bell
chapters.description: Five bells found, one missing. The herald wakes beneath the ice.
